endpointsTested.GET /api/dashboard/director: 200 (after using a real director token; an earlier mismatched delivery_manager token returned 403 — not a product bug)

kpis.label: Active projects
kpis.note: ?status=ACTIVE is a fully-effective client-side filter; 10 ACTIVE projects in the 40-row directory.

kpis.label: At-risk projects
kpis.note: Law-9 lie. KPI shows 7 (amber+red over the 10 ACTIVE/ON_HOLD projects). The drilldown's `rag` param is NOT in ProjectsPage FILTER_DEFAULTS, so it is silently ignored and the page renders ALL 40 projects (incl. 20 CLOSED + 10 COMPLETED) with no RAG filter. Card says 7, list shows 40.

kpis.label: Budget variance · portfolio
kpis.note: Variance is +44.9% (under budget; AC 2.15M vs budget 3.90M) and finance.overBudgetProjectCount=0, so the over-budget list correctly resolves to 0. HOWEVER the drilldown filter value `over` does NOT match the ProjectsPage budgetStatus enum (GREEN|YELLOW|RED) — the filter compares `rec.budgetStatus !== 'over'`, which would exclude every project with a known budgetStatus. It returns 0 here only because 0 is also the true over-budget count. The param contract is broken; it would also show 0 even when projects ARE over budget. Not flagged as a hard mismatch because both numbers are 0 today.

kpis.label: Utilisation
kpis.note: Links to /people (unfiltered org directory), not to a count that should equal 32%. No numeric equivalence to compare; value itself derives cleanly from the director endpoint.

kpis.label: Open positions
kpis.note: Unit mismatch. KPI counts open POSITIONS (36 ProjectPosition rows with fillStatus=OPEN). The drilldown ?hasOpenGaps=true lists PROJECTS that have >0 open positions = 33 projects. 36 positions are spread across 33 projects, so the card number (36) can never equal the list length (33). A user clicking the 36 lands on a 33-row list.

findings: At-risk projects: card=7 (amber+red over 10 active) vs drilldown /projects?rag=AMBER,RED shows 40 (rag param ignored — not in FILTER_DEFAULTS).
Open positions: card=36 (open ProjectPosition rows) vs drilldown /projects?hasOpenGaps=true shows 33 (projects with >0 gaps) — position count vs project count unit mismatch.
Budget variance drilldown ?budgetStatus=over uses value 'over' which does not match the GREEN|YELLOW|RED enum the ProjectsPage filter compares against; consistent at 0 today only by coincidence.
evidence: Live as director noah.bennett (roles:[director]) on deliverit-test-v2. /dashboard/portfolio/summary -> {totalProjects:10, byRag:{amber:5,red:2}, totalOpenGaps:36}. /dashboards/director/finance -> {overBudgetProjectCount:0, totalBudget:3902906, totalActualCost:2151391}. /dashboard/director -> {staffingUtilisationRate:31.5}. Drilldown source /api/projects -> 40 items (10 ACTIVE, 20 CLOSED, 10 COMPLETED); 33 projects have openPositionsCount>0 summing to 36 open positions. ProjectsPage FILTER_DEFAULTS (frontend/src/routes/projects/ProjectsPage.tsx L31-43) has no `rag` key, so ?rag=AMBER,RED is a no-op -> at-risk drilldown returns 40 not 7. hasOpenGaps filter (L204) keeps projects -> 33 not 36. All 6 KPI/drilldown endpoints returned HTTP 200.
